messages:
Priya Patel: Pushing a compact pool tile mock for review. Goal: show Min/Max, Burst state, selected GPU pool, and a tiny 'latency target' indicator in one horizontal row. Fig: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/2339123456/compact-tile.png
Alex Chen: Nice. Quick reaction: the latency indicator is purely visual now. We need a visible numeric readout for keyboard users and a label for screen readers.
Maya Rivera: Also the pool name collides with the numbers on smaller widths. Suggest truncating pool name and moving Min/Max to a stacked micro-layout to save horizontal space.
Jordan Lee: Stacked numbers are fine but watch hit areas. Touch targets must remain >=24px. We'll need to reduce internal padding if we go that route.
Samir Gupta: Billing flag: when Burst is enabled, we need an affordance to show estimated incremental cost. Prefer a hover cost chip rather than persistent text to keep tile compact.
A11yBot: Automated scan: burst badge contrast = 2.6:1 (fails). latency rail contrast = 3.0:1 (fails). Recommend increasing color contrast or adding a pattern. Also add aria-labels: e.g., "Latency target: 150 ms" and ensure slider has aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow.
Alex Chen: Keyboard interactions: pool chevron = Tab stop, open with Enter/Space, navigate with Up/Down, select with Enter. Latency slider = Left/Right step 10ms; Home/End jump to min/max; show numeric tooltip on focus.
Maya Rivera: Microcopy tweak: use "Latency target" on the tile, keep "SLO" jargon in the expanded details panel. Rename "Burst" to "Burst (temp)" so users don't think it's a pool type.
Priya Patel: Decision proposals: 1) default min = 1 for Dedicated pools, 2) collapsed pool label for single-pool accounts, 3) show latency numeric for a11y, 4) burst estimated cost on hover with link to billing. Any objections?
Samir Gupta: No objections. For hover copy: "Approx. $0.04/min while active. See billing docs." Make sure it links to billing page.
Jordan Lee: Perf ask: can frontend lazy-load the latency micrograph and the cost chip only when the tile intersects viewport? I'll prototype an IntersectionObserver approach.
A11yBot: Reminder: include focus-visible styles (example token: `--focus-ring: 3px solid #FFB84D;`) and use role="alert" for validation errors like "Min cannot exceed Max".
Alex Chen: I'll update the Figma with truncated pool name + stacked min/max variant + accessible slider notes and share an updated link in ~45m.
Maya Rivera: I'll darken the latency rail and update the burst badge color to meet 4.5:1 contrast, then post the new mock.
Priya Patel: Thanks all. If perf numbers look good after Jordan's test, we'll approve this variant for the next round of usability testing.
